meta.position_scope: RB only. Fullbacks, receivers and quarterbacks are excluded from the product but remain in the team denominators, so carry share means share of all of a team's carries.
meta.inclusion_rule: >= 8 games in the window, OR on a current 2026 RB roster / priced by the current market

count_rules.carry: a rush attempt with a source-supplied rusher id, excluding two-point tries and quarterback kneels. A kneel is a clock event, not a carry. Measured rusher-id coverage: 100%.
count_rules.touch: carries plus receptions. Not carries plus targets — an uncaught pass is not a touch.
count_rules.carry_share: player carries over that team's carries in the same game; both numbers are retained
count_rules.target_share: player targets over that team's targets in the same game
count_rules.red_zone_carry: a carry whose source-supplied yardline is inside the opponent twenty

withheld_fields.reason: requires the nflverse participation file, which is ~37% covered for 2019-2022 and NOT PUBLISHED for 2024-2025. A snap share on that would describe whichever plays were charted.
same participation file, withheld for the same reason
